purpose_text.para: Controls the generation of an event stream from the physical counter, and access from EL1 to the physical counter and the EL1 physical timer.

configuration_text.para: If EL2 is not implemented, this register is RES0 from EL3.
Fields that control the generation of events from the event stream have an effect regardless of the current Exception level and whether EL2 is enabled in the current Security state.
All other fields have no effect if EL2 is not enabled in the current Security state.

field_description.para: Reserved, RES0.
This bit is RES0 in Non-secure and Secure state.

field_value_description.para: This control has no effect on CNTP_CTL_EL0.IMASK.
CNTP_CTL_EL0.IMASK behaves as if set to 1 for all purposes other than a direct read of the field.

This control applies regardless of the value of the CNTHCTL_EL2.ECV bit.

field_value_description.para: The CNTHCTL_EL2.EVNTI field applies to CNTPCT_EL0[15:0].
The CNTHCTL_EL2.EVNTI field applies to CNTPCT_EL0[23:8].

field_description.para: Reserved, RES0.
When HCR_EL2.TGE is 0 and the Effective value of HCR_EL2.{NV2, NV1, NV} is {1, 0, 1}, traps EL1 accesses to the specified EL1 virtual timer registers using the EL02 descriptors to EL2 as follows:
Accesses to CNTV_CTL_EL02 and CNTV_CVAL_EL02 are trapped to EL2 and reported with EC syndrome value 0x18.
If HCR_EL2.TGE is 1 or the Effective value of HCR_EL2.{NV2, NV1, NV} is not {1, 0, 1}, this control does not cause any instructions to be trapped.
If EL3 is implemented and EL2 is not implemented, behavior is as if this bit is 0 other than for the purpose of a direct read.

Traps EL0 and EL1 accesses to the EL1 virtual counter registers to EL2 when EL2 is enabled in the current Security state, as follows:

listitem.content: In AArch64 state, accesses to CNTVCT_EL0 and CNTVCTSS_EL0 are trapped to EL2 and reported using EC syndrome value 0x18, unless they are trapped by CNTKCTL_EL1.EL0VCTEN.
In AArch32 state, accesses to CNTVCT are trapped to EL2 and reported with EC syndrome value 0x04, unless they are trapped by CNTKCTL_EL1.EL0VCTEN or CNTKCTL.PL0VCTEN.

listitem.content: In AArch64 state, accesses to the following registers are trapped to EL2 and reported with EC syndrome value 0x18, unless they are trapped by CNTKCTL_EL1.EL0VTEN: CNTV_CTL_EL0. CNTV_CVAL_EL0. CNTV_TVAL_EL0.

In AArch32 state, MRC and MCR accesses to the following registers are trapped to EL2 and reported using EC syndrome value 0x03, and MCRR and MRRC accesses are trapped to EL2 and reported using EC syndrome value 0x04, unless they are trapped by CNTKCTL_EL1.EL0VTEN or CNTKCTL.PL0VTEN: CNTV_CTL. field_description.para: Reserved, RES0.
Enables the Enhanced Counter Virtualization functionality registers.
When the Enhanced Counter Virtualization is enabled, the behavior is as follows:

listitem.content: An MRS to CNTPCT_EL0 from either EL0 or EL1 that is not trapped will return the value (PCount<63:0> - CNTPOFF_EL2<63:0>).
The EL1 physical timer interrupt is triggered when ((PCount<63:0> - CNTPOFF_EL2<63:0>) - PCVal<63:0>) is greater than or equal to 0.

field_description.para: PCount<63:0> is the physical count returned when CNTPCT_EL0 is read from EL2 or EL3.
PCVal<63:0> is the EL1 physical timer compare value for this timer.
When HCR_EL2.TGE is 1 or SCR_EL3.{NS, EEL2} is {0, 0}, the Effective value of this field is 0.

field_value_description.para: Enhanced Counter Virtualization functionality is disabled.
Enhanced Counter Virtualization functionality is enabled.

field_description.para: Selects which bit of CNTPCT_EL0, as seen from EL2, is the trigger for the event stream generated from that counter when that stream is enabled.
If FEAT_ECV is implemented, and CNTHCTL_EL2.EVNTIS is 1, this field selects a trigger bit in the range 8 to 23 of CNTPCT_EL0.
Otherwise, this field selects a trigger bit in the range 0 to 15 of CNTPCT_EL0.
Controls which transition of the CNTPCT_EL0 trigger bit, as seen from EL2 and defined by EVNTI, generates an event when the event stream is enabled.

field_value_description.para: A 0 to 1 transition of the trigger bit triggers an event.
A 1 to 0 transition of the trigger bit triggers an event.

field_description.para: Enables the generation of an event stream from CNTPCT_EL0 as seen from EL2.

field_value_description.para: Disables the event stream.
Enables the event stream.

field_description.para: When HCR_EL2.TGE is 1, traps EL0 accesses to the frequency register and virtual counter registers to EL2, as follows:

listitem.content: In AArch64 state, accesses to the following registers are trapped to EL2 and reported with EC syndrome value 0x18: CNTVCT_EL0. CNTVCTSS_EL0. CNTFRQ_EL0 if CNTHCTL_EL2.EL0PCTEN is 0.

In AArch32 state, MRC and MCR accesses to the following registers are trapped and reported using EC syndrome value 0x03 and MRRC and MCRR accesses are trapped and reported using EC syndrome value 0x04: CNTVCT and if CNTHCTL.EL0PCTEN is 0, CNTFRQ.

field_description.para: If HCR_EL2.TGE is 0, the field is ignored for all purposes other than direct reads and writes of the register.
